ideas.pitch: Real-time AI-powered DDoS detection and 3D threat visualization platform for critical smart city infrastructure.
ideas.title: AegisGrid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning GraphGuard pattern by implementing multi-agent network attack simulation and visualization tailored specifically for the AI in Cybersecurity and Smart Cities tracks.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven NGINX and server log anomaly detection dashboard with automated incident response playbooks.
ideas.title: LogSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the UCC ACM Hackathon winner danphobic, providing immediate utility to security and operations teams through automated log analysis.

ideas.pitch: Graph-intelligence based risk detection and automated investigation platform for industrial supply chain finance.
ideas.title: AutoGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning architecture of Bito by combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to appeal to industry automation judges.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent autonomous traffic and utility grid optimization system for smart city congestion and resource management.
ideas.title: UrbanFlow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven multi-agent pipelines seen in top hackathons to urban planning challenges, fulfilling the AI in Smart Cities track requirements effectively.

ideas.pitch: Defense-in-depth personal security agent featuring prompt-injection hardening and real-time threat neutralization for industrial IoT.
ideas.title: ShieldAgent
